title: Complete Through Cutoff Inventory Evidence Enumeration Proof
purpose: Acquire exactly one durable FOOD-006I high-water cutoff and exhaust every exact-SKU ledger page through that same cutoff, returning one immutable ordered evidence set with terminal pagination proof.
rules: The operation acquires the FOOD-006I global cutoff exactly once.
Every ledger page is requested for the same exact SKU and the same acquired cutoff.
The first page begins after sequence zero.
Each later page begins after exactly the prior page nextCursor.
Absence of nextCursor is the only successful terminal exhaustion signal.
Every returned evidence sequence must remain strictly increasing across page boundaries.
Repeated, decreasing, skipped-continuation, malformed or otherwise inconsistent cursor state fails closed.
Every exact ledger evidence entry returned before terminal exhaustion is retained.
A cutoff of zero yields a successfully exhausted empty evidence set without page storage access.
A positive cutoff with zero exact-SKU ledger entries is also a valid exhausted set.
Post-cutoff inserts do not affect the exhausted set because every page is bound to the original fixed cutoff.
The result retains exact SKU, acquired cutoff and every ordered ledger entry.
The result is detached and deeply frozen.
Storage failures fail the whole operation without partial success.
Invalid exact SKU input fails before storage access.
FOOD-006J does not construct a FOOD-006C manifest.
FOOD-006J does not truncate evidence to FOOD-006C cardinality limits.
FOOD-006J does not call FOOD-006E manifest resolution.
FOOD-006J does not call FOOD-006F balance composition.
FOOD-006J does not establish authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
FOOD-006J does not establish capacity, availability, checkout, payment, fulfillment, accounting or rewards authority.
Migration 0005 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
cardinalityRationale: FOOD-006C permits at most 128 production batches.
FOOD-006C permits at most 128 movement identities per production batch.
FOOD-006I cursor pagination can legitimately enumerate exact-SKU evidence beyond those manifest limits.
Therefore FOOD-006J must preserve the complete ledger set independently rather than force it into a narrower manifest.
deferred: A lossless representation strategy between exhausted ledger evidence and bounded FOOD-006C manifests.
Manifest partitioning or another explicit complete evidence representation.
